title: Dash: remove the 'suspend delivery' button
symptom: The issue discusses the idea of removing the 'suspend delivery' button for Dash, as 'Disconnect pump' sets a zero TBR and resumes automatically, and there may be no good use-case to keep the suspend button.
fix: Remove the 'suspend delivery' button from the DASH tab, but keep the 'Resume' delivery function/button.
evidence_quote: Be sure to keep the "Resume" delivery function/button though. If a profile change doesn't get trough and the pod stays "stuck" in suspended" mode, the user should be able to "Resume" insulin delivery.
